reviewStandard: The six queued routes failed the pre-generation disease-class, neuroimmune-process, signaling-network, clinical-specificity, toxicological-evidence, or cross-species extrapolation gate. They received no marked prompt, no built-in generation call, and no raster. Controlled records, current reviews, and the current ATSDR toxicological synthesis were checked against the generated article corpus; conflicts and required resolution are preserved in the audit and review packets. Zero hashes are eligible for promotion.
promotionRule: No Batch 084 route is eligible for generation or promotion until its documented identity, scope, evidence-tier, representation, nomenclature, exposure, species, and causal conflicts are corrected and independently re-audited.

routeDecisions.reason: Distinct diseases, brain regions, metal observations, barriers, cell-death processes, aggregation, and gut-brain hypotheses are collapsed into one causal pathway.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Select a named disease and define specimen/region, metal species, method, comparator, pathology, effect direction, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: Glial, vascular, peripheral-immune, infectious, toxicant, and disease processes are merged using obsolete M1/M2 microglial framing.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define species, region, insult, time, cell markers/state data, compartment, measured mediator, comparator, and function using current nomenclature.

routeDecisions.reason: The canonical branch is treated as the whole NF-kappa B network while noncanonical signaling, dimer diversity, feedback, cell context, timing, and assay are omitted.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Specify canonical and noncanonical receptors, proteins, dimers, cell type, stimulus, time, localization, assay, and source-bound evidence.

routeDecisions.reason: Non-specific eczema is merged with localized, systemic, dietary, mucosal, diagnostic, regulatory, and treatment claims.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Select one presentation and route with confirmed sensitization context, acute/chronic morphology, differential diagnosis, and evidence-qualified systemic claims.

routeDecisions.reason: Human associations, placental transfer, mixed exposures, animal findings, biomonitoring, and proposed mechanisms are presented as one causal human lesion.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define nickel species, route, dose, timing, biomatrix, design, species, endpoint, mixture/confounder handling, comparator, uncertainty, and causal status.

routeDecisions.reason: One intraperitoneal rat study and broad mechanistic claims are generalized toward environmental human neurotoxicity.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Rebuild as a study-specific record or synthesis preserving chemical form, route, dose, tissue level, species/sex, assay, comparator, and human-extrapolation boundary.
